email.subject: RE: Summit MOB — Level 2 floor protection / BC-5102
email.body:
Hi,

Following up on my earlier email about Ridgeline Drywall tearing up the Level 2 west corridor floor protection at Summit. Accounting assigned that item BC-5102.

The labor and material tickets are in. Actual cost is $715, not my original $680 estimate. Please update BC-5102 to $715. This is the same floor-protection charge, not a new one.

Dana
